message.content: Hey, I need to send a quick message to Sarah. She’s been asking about when I’ll be back in Berlin for our anniversary dinner next week.

content.text: I can draft that for you. Do you want to keep it simple, or are you trying to confirm the specific date yet?

message.content: Just let her know I’m aiming for Friday the 5th. I’ve got a couple of backend deployments to wrap up first, but I’ll be there by Saturday morning at the latest.

content.text: Got it. Here’s a draft: "Hey Sarah, I’m aiming to be back for our anniversary on Friday the 5th. I have a few deployments to finish, but I’ll be there by Saturday morning. Can’t wait to see you." Shall I send it now?

message.content: Yes, send it. Also, while you’re at it, can you check my calendar for next Friday? I need to know if I’m free for dinner after I get back from the airport.

content.text: Looking at your calendar... Friday the 5th is clear after 18:00. You have a 30-minute slot open from 19:00 to 19:30, but nothing else booked until Sunday. It looks like you’re free for dinner.

message.content: Perfect. Okay, while we’re talking, I need to grab groceries for the week. I’m out of milk and eggs. Also, can you remind me what Go version I’m supposed to be running? I think I updated it over the weekend.

content.text: I’ve added milk and eggs to your shopping list. Regarding your Go version, you updated it on Saturday 28 March. You are now running 1.22.1.

message.content: Right, thanks. I remember updating it then. It’s definitely 1.22.1 now. I’ll need to check the compatibility with our Postgres drivers before I push the next commit. Anyway, add some spinach and chicken breast to the list too.

content.text: Added spinach and chicken breast to your list. Anything else for the week?

message.content: No, that’s it. Oh, and one more thing. My internet has been a bit spotty lately. I should probably call Deutsche Telekom to see if there’s an outage in my area or if it’s just my router acting up again.

content.text: I’ve noted that you need to contact Deutsche Telekom regarding your internet connection. I can set a reminder for you to call them if you’d like.

message.content: Yes, please. Set it for tomorrow morning at 9 AM. I’ll handle the rest of the work stuff then. Thanks.
